title: Rising from bowing
cue: What is said on rising and once standing
translation: Allah hears the one who praises Him.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 789: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/1296

when: On rising from bowing, then once standing
usage.evidence: Abu Hurayrah describes the Prophet ﷺ saying "sami'a Allahu liman hamidah" as he raised his back from bowing, then, standing, "Rabbana laka al-hamd" (al-Bukhari 789).

variants.label: Then, once standing: "Our Lord, to You belongs the praise."
